_doc: Source of truth for the nature/foliage set. docs/NATURE_ASSETS.md explains it, docs/NATURE_PROMPTS.md is generated from it (python tools/nature/nature_pipeline.py prompts). Edit here, never in the generated file.

style.anchor_note: Optional style reference: give a biome (or shared_style) an "anchor" image path and it is sent with every concept request for that group. None are set - the mana-well renders were rejected as references (2026-10-04), so prompts are text-only until a reference worth copying exists.

white.name: Plains
white.mood: sun-drenched orderly plains of golden wheat, pale limestone and white marble, warm noon light, a sense of order and harvest
white.palette: warm gold, cream limestone, sage green, soft sky-blue accents

blue.name: Islands
blue.mood: windswept coast and tidal flats, wet stone, sea spray and a calm arcane stillness
blue.palette: deep teal, sea blue, wet slate grey, sand beige, pearl accents

black.name: Swamp
black.mood: rotting bayou of black water, low mist, decay and quiet menace
black.palette: charcoal, deep aubergine, sickly olive, bone white, deep violet accents

red.name: Mountains
red.mood: volcanic badlands of cooling lava, ash and ember, heat shimmer
red.palette: basalt black, rust red, ember orange, ash grey, sulphur-yellow accents

green.name: Forest
green.mood: primeval old-growth forest, thick moss, dappled light and wild growth
green.palette: deep forest green, moss green, bark brown, cream and red mushroom accents

scatter._doc: World layout of the one 512 m TerraBrush zone (centred on the origin; pixel = world + 256). Biome wedges are 72 degrees wide around each lane angle.

tiers._doc: Scatter defaults per tier. spacing_m is TerraBrush's objectFrequency (one candidate per N metres), density the chance a candidate is used before noise clumping. Assets may override any field.

assets.subject: small cluster of crystal shards
assets.details: four short stubby hexagonal crystal shards of different sizes leaning outward from one point, the crystal is colourless with a dense milky white inside and a clear outer skin, glowing softly from within as if lit by a bright white light inside its core - brightest at the core, fading towards the clear edges - but the glow stays strictly inside the crystal: no halo, no bloom, no light rays, no light cast onto the background, crisp clean edges, no colour tint anywhere, no base or pedestal, the crystals rising straight out of an invisible ground

assets._doc: Second shard-cluster variant: the user approved both concepts (v1 -> crystal-shard-cluster, v2 -> this). Its concept v1.png is a copy of crystal-shard-cluster/v2.png.

assets.subject: crystal cluster
assets.details: seven hexagonal crystals of very different lengths fanning out from one root, sharp pointed tips, one crystal broken off halfway, the crystal is colourless with a dense milky white inside and a clear outer skin, glowing softly from within as if lit by a bright white light inside its core - brightest at the core, fading towards the clear edges - but the glow stays strictly inside the crystal: no halo, no bloom, no light rays, no light cast onto the background, crisp clean edges, no colour tint anywhere, no base or pedestal, the crystals rising straight out of an invisible ground

assets.subject: split crystal geode
assets.details: a rough rounded boulder of plain mid-grey stone cracked open on one side to reveal a hollow densely lined with crystals; the crystals are colourless with a dense milky white inside, glowing softly from within as if lit by a bright white light deep inside the hollow, the glow strictly inside the crystals - no halo, no bloom, no light rays, no light spilling onto the stone or the background - no colour tint anywhere, the stone shell a darker plain neutral grey that does not glow, so stone and crystal are clearly different in brightness

assets.subject: tall crystal spire
assets.details: one tall faceted crystal spire with a slight lean and a sharp tip, two smaller crystals growing from its foot, the crystal is colourless with a dense milky white inside and a clear outer skin, glowing softly from within as if lit by a bright white light inside its core - brightest at the core, fading towards the clear edges - but the glow stays strictly inside the crystal: no halo, no bloom, no light rays, no light cast onto the background, crisp clean edges, no colour tint anywhere, no base or pedestal, the crystals rising straight out of an invisible ground

assets.subject: golden wheat grass tufts
assets.details: see docs/GRASS_ATLAS_PROMPTS.md - this sheet already exists

assets.subject: meadow wildflower clumps
assets.details: Golden buttercups, amber marigold-like blooms and deep cornflower-blue flowers on short sage-green stems, five to nine flower heads per clump. No white or cream petals anywhere - every petal is a saturated gold, amber or deep blue

assets.subject: tall golden meadow grass clumps with feathery seed plumes
assets.details: Waist-high stalks of deep amber grass with heavy bronze seed plumes and one or two tall sunflower-like golden blooms in some clumps. No straw-white, no bleached tips

assets.subject: clipped boxwood hedge bush
assets.details: a neatly trimmed rounded-cube shrub of dense small sage-green leaves, neatly clipped into a rounded block by a gardener, a few short woody stems visible at the base

assets.subject: flowering sunbloom shrub
assets.details: a round airy shrub of sage-green leaf clusters dotted with small saturated golden five-petal flowers, slightly lopsided natural shape

assets.subject: slender silver birch tree
assets.details: a tall straight trunk of white bark with dark horizontal markings, splitting into two upper limbs that carry three or four separate leafy canopy clusters of pale golden-green leaves

assets.subject: gnarled olive-like sunleaf tree
assets.details: a short twisted grey trunk that splits low into three crooked limbs, carrying a wide flat-topped silvery sage canopy broken into leafy clumps, a few tiny golden fruits

assets.subject: lone majestic sun oak
assets.details: a massive solitary oak with a broad buttressed trunk and a huge dome canopy of warm golden leaves built from large leafy clusters, sunlight-coloured, the kind of tree that marks a crossroads on open plains

assets.subject: cluster of flat limestone stones
assets.details: four or five flat, rounded pale limestone stones of different sizes lying together, sun-bleached cream with faint grey speckle

assets.subject: layered limestone outcrop
assets.details: stacked flat-topped slabs of pale cream limestone stepping down to one side, clean horizontal strata, small tufts of moss in the seams

assets.subject: cluster of puffball mushrooms
assets.details: five round cream puffball mushrooms of different sizes with soft golden-brown speckles, one split open at the top

assets.subject: coastal sea-grass tufts
assets.details: see docs/GRASS_ATLAS_PROMPTS.md - this sheet already exists

assets.subject: sea lavender and sea holly clumps
assets.details: Low clumps of spiky steel-blue sea holly and sprays of deep violet sea lavender on dark teal stems. No pale mint, no frosted tips

assets.subject: tall coastal dune reed clumps
assets.details: Stiff upright deep teal reeds with dark blue-green seed spikes, bent slightly by wind, all leaning the same way

assets.subject: spiky sea holly bush
assets.details: a dense mound of stiff spiny steel-blue leaves with a dozen thistle-like blue flower heads on short stalks

assets.subject: tide hydrangea shrub
assets.details: a rounded shrub of broad dark-teal leaves crowned by large ball-shaped clusters of deep blue flowers, each cluster a dense round puff

assets.subject: windswept coastal pine
assets.details: a trunk bent hard to one side by sea wind, branches all reaching the same way, needles grouped into flat layered dark blue-green canopy pads like a giant bonsai

assets.subject: mangrove tree on arching stilt roots
assets.details: a short trunk lifted off the ground on a cage of arching stilt roots, a compact dome canopy of glossy dark-teal leaves, barnacles and pale tide marks on the lower roots

assets.subject: sea stack rock arch
assets.details: a tall eroded column of layered blue-grey rock with a natural arch worn through its base, wet salt-stained ledges and a few barnacle patches near the bottom, bare rock only

assets.subject: cluster of smooth beach pebbles
assets.details: six smooth rounded pebbles in blue-grey, slate and sand tones, one flat skipping stone on top

assets.subject: low hexagonal basalt column formation
assets.details: a tight group of hexagonal stone columns of different heights forming natural stepping platforms, wet blue-grey stone with pale salt rings

assets.subject: cluster of lantern-cap mushrooms
assets.details: six bell-shaped translucent blue mushroom caps on thin pale stems, softly glowing from inside like lanterns

assets.subject: bleached driftwood log
assets.details: a long sea-smoothed silver-grey driftwood trunk with three broken-off branch stubs and a tangle of roots at one end

assets.subject: giant clam shell
assets.details: a large ridged clam shell half open, wavy scalloped rim, pearl-pale inside with a single blue pearl, barnacles on the outer shell

assets.subject: blighted swamp grass tufts
assets.details: see docs/GRASS_ATLAS_PROMPTS.md - this sheet already exists

assets.subject: nightshade clumps
assets.details: Low clumps of dark olive leaves with drooping star-shaped deep violet flowers and a few glossy black berries. Dark values, but keep violet and olive readable

assets.subject: bog cattail reed clumps
assets.details: Tall dark olive reed blades, some broken and drooping, with thick dark brown cattail heads on stiff stalks

assets.subject: thorn bramble tangle
assets.details: a low knotted mound of black thorny briar stems with sparse dark olive leaves and clusters of small glossy violet-black berries

assets.subject: drooping swamp willow
assets.details: a twisted leaning trunk with a hollow, its canopy a heavy curtain of long hanging dark-olive leaf strands grouped into long drapes that almost touch the ground

assets.subject: swamp cypress with knees
assets.details: a flared buttressed trunk standing in a ring of knobbly cypress knees, a sparse ragged canopy of dark needles, long strands of grey hanging moss draped from the branches

assets.subject: leaning dead snag tree
assets.details: a leafless dead tree leaning at an angle, peeling grey-black bark, a few long spiky bare branches, a split near the top

assets.subject: cluster of wet slate shards
assets.details: four thin flaky shards of wet black slate tilted against each other, faint violet sheen, a little dark moss at the base

assets.subject: group of half-sunk bog stones
assets.details: three rounded dark charcoal boulders half sunk into mud, slick with olive moss and grey lichen on their tops

assets.subject: cluster of tall witch toadstools
assets.details: five spindly toadstools of different heights with pointed deep violet caps, pale bone stems and faintly glowing lilac gills

assets.subject: rotten log covered in bracket fungus
assets.details: a short rotting log, bark sloughing off, covered in rows of stacked shelf fungus in olive, bone and dark violet

assets.subject: cluster of giant swamp spore pods
assets.details: four bulbous swollen fungal pods on thick stalks, mottled aubergine skin with glowing violet pores, one pod split open

assets.subject: floating cluster of bog lily pads
assets.details: five flat round dark-olive lily pads lying flat, each with a notch, two closed deep violet lily buds, completely flat underside

assets.subject: volcanic red grass tufts
assets.details: see docs/GRASS_ATLAS_PROMPTS.md - this sheet already exists

assets.subject: ember flower clumps
assets.details: Low clumps of dark charcoal-green leaves with flame-shaped blossoms in saturated orange and crimson, petals curling upward like little fires

assets.subject: tall scorched spike-reed clumps
assets.details: Stiff rust-red spiky reeds with blackened burnt tips and a few dark crimson seed spikes. No pink, no salmon

assets.subject: ember thornbush
assets.details: a dense bush of black thorny branches carrying clumps of crimson and ember-orange leaves, like a bush caught mid-burn

assets.subject: fire succulent rosette
assets.details: an agave-like rosette of thick pointed fleshy leaves, crimson at the tips fading to dark rust at the base, one tall flower stalk with an orange bloom

assets.subject: dragonblood tree
assets.details: a thick trunk splitting into a dense fan of upward branches, topped by a broad flat umbrella canopy of stiff dark leaves, dark crimson sap streaks running down the bark

assets.subject: charred pine tree
assets.details: a tall fire-blackened pine with most needles gone, a few clumps of rust-brown needles left near the top, cracked bark showing glowing ember-orange seams

assets.subject: ancient fireheart tree
assets.details: a huge twisted tree of black bark split by molten orange veins, a wide canopy of flame-orange and crimson leaf clumps, roots gripping cooled lava rock

assets.subject: cluster of porous lava rocks
assets.details: five small pitted porous lava rocks in black and dark rust, rough and bubbly

assets.subject: cooled pillow lava mound
assets.details: a low mound of rounded cooled lava blobs piled together, black crust with faint glowing orange cracks between the blobs

assets.subject: red sandstone mesa chunk
assets.details: a flat-topped block of layered red and ochre sandstone with crisp horizontal strata, one corner collapsed into a pile of fallen slabs

assets.subject: ember cap mushrooms on charred wood
assets.details: a short chunk of charred black wood with six flat orange mushroom caps growing from it, the caps glowing like embers along their rims

assets.subject: sulphur vent rock
assets.details: a low cracked rock mound with an open vent hole at the top, crusted with bright sulphur-yellow and white mineral deposits around the opening

assets.subject: lush forest grass tufts
assets.details: see docs/GRASS_ATLAS_PROMPTS.md - this sheet already exists

assets.subject: clover and woodland flower clumps
assets.details: Low clumps of deep green clover leaves with small saturated violet, magenta and yellow woodland flowers. No pale or white petals

assets.subject: forest fern clumps
assets.details: Arching fern fronds in deep saturated green, each frond broad with clearly separated chunky leaflets, five to eight fronds per clump

assets.subject: round leafy forest bush
assets.details: a full rounded bush built from several overlapping dense leaf clusters in deep and mid greens, a few twigs poking out

assets.subject: berry bush
assets.details: a loose leafy bush of deep green leaves hung with clusters of glossy red berries

assets.subject: broad forest oak
assets.details: a thick mossy trunk with exposed roots, heavy spreading branches carrying a wide canopy of large dense leaf clusters in deep and mid greens

assets.subject: tall forest fir
assets.details: a straight trunk with tiers of drooping layered branches forming a narrow cone of dark blue-green needles, each tier a distinct layer

assets.subject: young forest sapling
assets.details: a thin young tree with a slightly crooked stem and two small leaf clusters in fresh deep green

assets.subject: cluster of mossy river stones
assets.details: five rounded grey river stones with patches of bright moss on their tops

assets.subject: root-bound boulder
assets.details: a large grey boulder gripped by thick twisting tree roots that wrap over it and dive into the ground on both sides, moss in the crevices

assets.subject: cluster of red-capped toadstools
assets.details: five toadstools with round red caps dotted with cream spots and thick cream stems, different heights, one tipped over

assets.subject: giant forest mushroom
assets.details: a towering mushroom with a thick curved pale stem and a broad cream-and-moss-green cap, smaller mushrooms around its foot, softly glowing green gills under the cap

assets.subject: mossy tree stump
assets.details: an old cut tree stump with visible growth rings on top, thick moss over one side, roots spreading at the base and two small mushrooms

shared_style._doc: Style for assets with "biome": "shared" - generated once, colourless, and tinted per biome in the engine (docs/NATURE_ASSETS.md, 3a).
shared_style.mood: a neutral glowing magical crystal that will be recoloured later to fit any of five biomes
shared_style.palette: completely colourless: milky white quartz with a clear outer skin and a soft white inner glow, pure white highlights, no hue anywhere
